summary: Titus voted Yea on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act directing IHRA's definition into federal education-discrimination enforcement, and holds endorsements from the Democratic Majority for Israel PAC and the Jewish Democratic Council of America. That record anchors her E. She did vote against the Israel Security Supplemental Appropriations Act in November 2023, co-led a bipartisan letter protecting humanitarian aid delivery to Gaza, and affirmed UNLV students' right to pro-Palestine protest in May 2024.
